name: Subsystem Relation
description: Z1 is a subsystem of Z2 when both are resultants with nested component vectors and restricted connections.

elements.text: Z1 is a subsystem of Z2 via injective φ embedding VSCR1 into VSCR2, HEq on components and resultants, and CSCR1 ↔ embedded pairs in CSCR2 ∩ subsystem port pairs (textbook (iv)).
